adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `isTeamEventType` was changed from enum comparisons (`SchedulingType.COLLECTIVE` / `SchedulingType.ROUND_ROBIN`) to raw string checks: `['COLLECTIVE','ROUND_ROBIN'].includes(eventType.schedulingType)` (and later `eventType.schedulingType === 'COLLECTIVE'`). This duplicates string literals and no longer leverages the enum as a single source of truth, reducing compile-time safety if scheduling type values are renamed/changed.
